# ServiceLane POS

> ServiceLane POS is an in-development restaurant point-of-sale system for
> independent businesses. It is not production-ready.

The project uses TypeScript, React, Vite, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, Node.js,
and pnpm. It is designed for one installation per restaurant business on its
local network, using a dedicated PostgreSQL database.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hijazi313/servicelane-pos/main/README.md): Project overview, status, technology stack, setup, and repository structure.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hijazi313/servicelane-pos/main/docs/architecture/README.md): System structure, module boundaries, and dependency rules.
- [Project tracker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hijazi313/servicelane-pos/main/docs/planning/TRACKER.md): Current work, acceptance status, and verification limits.
- [Project scope](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hijazi313/servicelane-pos/main/docs/project-scope.md): Product scope and delivery boundaries.

## Code and modules

- [API](https://github.com/Hijazi313/servicelane-pos/tree/main/apps/api): NestJS backend, business modules, and database migrations.
- [Web application](https://github.com/Hijazi313/servicelane-pos/tree/main/apps/web): React frontend.
- [Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hijazi313/servicelane-pos/main/apps/api/src/modules/menu/docs/README.md): Menu catalogue documentation.
- [Orders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hijazi313/servicelane-pos/main/apps/api/src/modules/orders/docs/README.md): Order capture documentation.
- [Kitchen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hijazi313/servicelane-pos/main/apps/api/src/modules/kitchen/docs/README.md): Kitchen preparation documentation.
- [Billing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hijazi313/servicelane-pos/main/apps/api/src/modules/billing/docs/README.md): Billing and settlement documentation.
